deviation.eventDescription: One DeviantArt deviation with metadata written to the dataset. Deviations that are skipped (mature, older than sinceDate), not found or fail are free.

profile.eventDescription: One DeviantArt user profile (watchers, deviations, pageviews and more) written to the dataset.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Synthetic start event (covers the first 5 s of compute).
